endpointKind: plain Ollama on the machine that ran it

tools.name: chat
tools.description: Send a message to the FallCore proxy (Anthropic-API-compatible), which answers on the local model first and falls through to a frontier model only when it must. Returns the text, the tier that answered and, from the proxy, its cost. Plain Ollama answers this too.

model.description: Model id. Default: FALLCORE_MODEL, else claude-sonnet-5-5 (the FallCore proxy answers locally first whatever is named; plain Ollama needs one of its own models)

force_frontier.description: Ask the proxy to skip the local model

tools.name: health
tools.description: Status of the FallCore proxy and its local model backend. Needs the FallCore proxy (plain Ollama has no /health).

tools.name: stats
tools.description: The proxy's own counts: local against frontier calls, tokens, cost, by tool and by model. Needs the FallCore proxy.

tools.name: models
tools.description: The models this deployment offers (the proxy's list, or Ollama's own).

tools.name: recent_logs
tools.description: The last 50 prompt and response pairs the proxy logged (needs the admin key, FALLCORE_ADMIN_KEY). Needs the FallCore proxy.

tools.name: forge_stack
tools.description: Ask the FallCore Factory to build a branded FallCore deployment for a company. Returns the forge's metadata (id, size); the ZIP itself comes from the factory's own page.

vertical.description: legal | procurement | healthcare | finance | fitness | education | manufacturing | realestate | hospitality | agency | ngo | other

frontier_spend_gbp.description: What they spend on frontier AI APIs a year, in pounds (the factory uses it in its own projection)

tools.name: factory_tiers
tools.description: The FallCore Factory's tiers and their hardware.
